segments.name: Pharmaceutical
segments.description: Develops, manufactures and commercializes innovative medicines and therapies for people living with rare diseases.
segments.evidence: Zevra manages its business activities on a consolidated basis and operates as a single operating segment dedicated to the research and development, manufacturing, commercialization and sale of innovative medicines and therapies.

revenueModel.text: Zevra earns revenue from sales of MIPLYFFA and OLPRUVA, reimbursements under the global expanded access program, and royalties and milestone payments on AZSTARYS net sales.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company primarily derives its revenue from MIPLYFFA and OLPRUVA product sales, reimbursements received under the global EAP, and royalties or net sales milestone payments generated under the AZSTARYS License Agreement.

changes.text: In February 2023, the company changed its name to Zevra Therapeutics, Inc.
changes.evidence: In February 2023, we changed our name to Zevra Therapeutics, Inc.

changes.text: In 2023, Zevra completed the acquisition of Acer Therapeutics, adding OLPRUVA and celiprolol.
changes.evidence: On November 17, 2023, we completed the acquisition of Acer Therapeutics, Inc. ("Acer"), pursuant to which Acer became a wholly-owned subsidiary of Zevra.

changes.text: In 2022, Zevra purchased all assets and operations of Orphazyme related to arimoclomol.
changes.evidence: In May 2022, we purchased all of the assets and operations of Orphazyme A/S ("Orphazyme") related to arimoclomol.
